card.name: Linking words in dosing label text
card.fires_on: Small linking words, spaces before numbers, and partial words in oncology and biologic drug label dosing sections, such as 'in combination with', 'select patients for', 'every 4 weeks'.

modes.label: Linking words
modes.description: Short words like with, for, of after a treatment or dosage phrase.
modes.example: Refer to the Prescribing Information for the agents administered in combination<< with>> KEYTRUDA for recommended dos

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space just before a number in a schedule or weight.
